mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD b WHERE b.BOARDTYPE NOT IN (10, 11)
AND UPPER(b.BOARDTITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(b.BOARDCONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(b.BOARDNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND (UPPER(b.BOARDTITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(b.BOARDCONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ROWNUM rnum, sub.* FROM ( SELECT b.BOARDID AS boardId, b.BOARDTYPE AS boardType, b.BOARDTITLE AS boardTitle, b.BOARDCONTENT AS boardContent, b.BOARDNAME AS boardName, b.BOARDDATE AS boardDate, b.MEMNO AS memNo, NVL(b.BOARDVIEWCOUNT, 0) AS boardViewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE l WHERE l.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND l.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND c.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE) AS commentCount FROM BOARD b WHERE b.BOARDTYPE NOT IN (10, 11)
AND UPPER(b.BOARDTITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(b.BOARDCONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND UPPER(b.BOARDNAME) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%'
AND (UPPER(b.BOARDTITLE) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(b.BOARDCONTENT) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%')
ORDER BY likeCount DESC, b.BOARDID DESC
ORDER BY NVL(b.BOARDVIEWCOUNT, 0) DESC, b.BOARDID DESC
ORDER BY commentCount DESC, b.BOARDID DESC
ORDER BY b.BOARDID DESC
) sub WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE rnum >= #{startRow}

SELECT b.BOARDID AS boardId, b.BOARDTYPE AS boardType, b.BOARDTITLE AS boardTitle, b.BOARDCONTENT AS boardContent, b.BOARDNAME AS boardName, b.BOARDDATE AS boardDate, b.MEMNO AS memNo, NVL(b.BOARDVIEWCOUNT, 0) AS boardViewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE l WHERE l.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND l.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE) AS likeCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.BOARDID = b.BOARDID AND c.BOARDTYPE = b.BOARDTYPE) AS commentCount FROM BOARD b WHERE b.BOARDID = #{boardId}

SELECT c.COMMENTSID AS commentsId, c.BOARDID AS boardId, c.BOARDTYPE AS boardType, c.COMMENTSCONTENT AS commentsContent, c.COMMENTSNAME AS commentsName, c.COMMENTSDATE AS commentsDate, c.COMMENTSNO AS commentsNo, c.MEMNO AS memNo, c.PARENTBOARDNO AS parentBoardNo, c.PARENTBOARDID AS parentBoardId, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENTS_LIKE cl WHERE cl.COMMENTSID = c.COMMENTSID) AS likeCount FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.BOARDID = #{boardId} START WITH c.PARENTBOARDID IS NULL CONNECT BY PRIOR c.COMMENTSID = c.PARENTBOARDID ORDER SIBLINGS BY c.COMMENTSID ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM COMMENTS_LIKE WHERE COMMENTSID IN ( SELECT COMMENTSID FROM COMMENTS START WITH COMMENTSID = #{value} CONNECT BY PRIOR COMMENTSID = PARENTBOARDID )
DELETE FROM COMMENTS WHERE COMMENTSID IN ( SELECT COMMENTSID FROM COMMENTS START WITH COMMENTSID = #{value} CONNECT BY PRIOR COMMENTSID = PARENTBOARDID )
